fullContentHtml:
Delhi High Court JJA Mains Admit Card 2026 – Full Details

High Court of Delhi has released the mains admit card for the Junior Judicial Assistant JJA / Restorer. This recruitment was released for 152 posts. Applications for the Delhi High Court JJA / Restorer Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 04 February 2026, to 23 February 2026. The mains examination is going to be conducted on 04 October 2026. Candidates who had appeared in this Examination can download their Delhi High Court JJA Mains Admit Card 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 04 February 2026
  • Last Date : 23 February 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 23 February 2026
  • Form Correction Last Date : 26 February to 01 March
  • Exam Date : 22 March 2026
  • Admit Card : Before Exam
  • Answer Key : 24 March 2026
  • Result : 25 April 2026
  • Mains Exam Date : 24 May 2026 (Postponed)
  • Revised Result : 07 September 2026
  • New Mains Exam Date : 04 October 2026
  • Mains Exam City Details : 23 September 2026
  • Mains Admit Card : 29 September 2026

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 1500/-
  • SC, ST, PH : Rs. 1300/-

How to Check Answer Key

  1. Click on the official Answer Key link provided below.
  2. Select your Question Paper Series / Shift / Exam Date.
  3. Download the official Answer Key PDF.
  4. Compare your answers and submit objections if required before the deadline.
